chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning’s Seven-Day Ultimatum Shakes Snowdragon Mountain to Its Core
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning delivers a chilling ultimatum to Snowdragon Mountain. A single letter terrifies four Zifu Disciples, forcing a Primal Daoist to personally mobilize against him. The storm is brewing.
og_title: Ji Ning’s Final Warning: A Name Written in Sword-Intent
og_description: The quiet is over. Ji Ning’s letter, carrying the crushing weight of his Sword Intent, sends a shockwave through Snowdragon Mountain, setting the stage for an epic clash of titans.
twitter_title: Ji Ning Drops the Hammer! A Seven-Day Ultimatum That Shakes the Xianxia World
twitter_description: Ji Ning is not messing around. A single letter makes Snowdragon Mountain’s Primal Daoist ride out to face him. The hype is real!

lore_anchors.definition: In Xianxia, a paired magic talisman that breaks simultaneously to send a pre-arranged signal across vast distances, used for urgent communication in sects.
One of the three Primal Daoist overlords of Snowdragon Mountain, a cultivator of over a thousand years at the peak of his realm, known for his obsession with beauty and his formidable power.
The three supreme leaders of Snowdragon Mountain: the Snowfeather Daoist, the Cold Sun Daoist, and the Black Dragon Daoist, each reigning over their own peak.
